title: What Are Your Best AliExpress Buys This Year?
body:
Happy New Financial Year! How were the fireworks where you live?
With AliExpress' coupon codes and TopCashback's 20% back on affiliated products, I thought it'd be worthwhile sharing the best items we've picked up that others might not have considered buying on AliExpress - especially things that haven't been shared as deal posts.
Example: I've picked up these push pin and bulldog clip magnets. They're always this price on AliExpress and therefore don't warrant a deal post of their own, but they're cheaper on AliExpress than I can find in Australia (e.g. Bunnings) yet are stronger than similar magnets I've bought locally.
